full_judgment: 4. The defendant No. 1 alone appeared and contested the suit by filing a written statement. His main case is that Md Haris transferred the entire land of RS Khatian No. 604 to him by way of pattan by granting a rent receipt. The defendant has since pattan been in possession of the entire land of the Khatian. He also denied the possession of Abdul Barik as well as of the plaintiff in the suit land.
